situation: Renting in Chicago, lease says 60 days written notice. I want to be out Nov 30. The property manager is Denise at a small management company.
reply:
Dear Denise,
I'm writing to give notice that I will be vacating 2217 N Oakley Ave, Unit 3B, with my tenancy ending on 30 November 2026, in line with the 60-day written notice requirement in section 14 of my lease. I'll pay November's rent as usual and return all keys and the fob on the 30th. Could we schedule the move-out inspection for that afternoon? Please confirm in writing that you've received this notice.
Thank you for three easy years here.
Marcus Lee
note: Sent on 1 October at the latest to meet 60 days; check whether the lease wants email, letter or both.

situation: Je suis propriétaire d'un T2 à Nantes, le bail se termine le 31 mai 2027 et ma fille va y habiter. Je veux prévenir les locataires, Julien et Sarah, avant d'envoyer la lettre recommandée.
reply: Bonjour Julien et Sarah, je voulais vous prévenir personnellement avant le courrier officiel : je ne renouvellerai pas votre bail qui se termine le 31 mai 2027, car ma fille va venir habiter l'appartement. Vous recevrez le congé par lettre recommandée cette semaine, avec les six mois de préavis prévus par la loi. Je sais qu'un déménagement est un vrai bouleversement, et je vous ferai volontiers une attestation de bon locataire. Si vous trouvez un logement plus tôt, dites-le-moi et on s'arrangera sur les dates.
note: Ce message prévient, il ne remplace pas le congé en recommandé avec accusé de réception.

situation: 在上海租房，合同到明年3月，公司把我调去深圳，11月底就得走。房东是位王阿姨，合同写提前退租押金不退。想跟她商量一下。
reply: 王阿姨您好，公司把我调到深圳工作，所以想跟您商量能不能在11月30日提前退租。我可以帮您找下一位租客，配合带看，房租一直交到新租客入住为止。押金的事也想跟您商量一个两边都合适的办法，这周六上午方便通个电话吗？
note: 提前退租是请求不是通知：先把对方的损失补上，再谈押金。谈妥的内容一定要落到书面。

situation: I emailed my landlord Mr Okoye yesterday giving a month's notice to leave my flat in Bristol on 28 October. He says it's invalid because it's a rolling tenancy and notice has to end on the last day of a rent period. Rent is due on the 15th. I think he's right.
reply: Hi Mr Okoye, thanks for pointing that out. I've checked, and you're right that notice needs to end on the last day of a rent period. Please treat this email as my notice to leave 7 Cotham Road, Flat 3, with the tenancy ending on Saturday 14 November 2026. I'll pay the rent due on 15 October as usual and return both sets of keys on the 14th. Could you confirm in writing that you've received this?
note: When they're right about the rule, re-serve correctly straight away instead of arguing. Check Shelter or Citizens Advice if you're unsure of the dates.

situation: Three of us rent a house on a joint lease through Parkside Lettings (property manager Owen). My housemate Tomás is moving to Madrid at the end of November. Aoife and I want to stay, and our friend Hana wants to take his room.
reply: Hi Owen, I'm writing on behalf of the tenants at 42 Linden Street. Tomás Ruiz is moving out at the end of November, and Aoife Byrne and I would like to stay on. Could we replace Tomás on the lease with a new tenant, Hana Mori, from Tuesday 1 December 2026? She can send her references and ID this week for your checks. Please let us know what paperwork you need, and whether Tomás should also give notice separately. Could you confirm the next steps in writing? Thanks, Maya Collins
note: Changing a joint tenancy is a request, not a notice. Get the new arrangement confirmed in writing before Tomás hands back his keys, since one tenant's notice can end the whole tenancy in some places.

situation: Ich wohne in Leipzig zur Miete, unbefristeter Vertrag, gesetzliche Kündigungsfrist drei Monate. Ich ziehe für einen neuen Job nach Hamburg und will zum 31. Dezember raus. Die Hausverwaltung ist Mahler Immobilien, zuständig ist Frau Brandt.
reply:
Sehr geehrte Frau Brandt,
hiermit kündige ich das Mietverhältnis über die Wohnung Karl-Heine-Straße 48, 2. OG links, 04229 Leipzig, fristgerecht zum 31. Dezember 2026, gemäß der gesetzlichen Kündigungsfrist von drei Monaten (§ 573c BGB). Das unterschriebene Original geht Ihnen heute per Einschreiben zu. Für Besichtigungen mit Nachmietern bin ich werktags ab 17 Uhr flexibel. Für die Übergabe mit Zählerablesung schlage ich Montag, den 28. Dezember, vor. Bitte bestätigen Sie mir den Eingang der Kündigung schriftlich.
Vielen Dank für die angenehmen Jahre hier.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Jonas Weber
note: In Deutschland braucht die Kündigung die Schriftform mit Unterschrift; die E-Mail ist nur die Vorabinfo, der Brief muss bis zum dritten Werktag im Oktober ankommen.

situation: I asked my landlord Greg if I could end my lease on Nov 30 instead of March 31 because I'm moving to Denver for work. He replied 'A lease is a lease, you owe rent through March.' Rent is $1,850. I don't want a fight.
reply: Hi Greg, I understand you'd rather keep the lease as it is, and I'm not asking you to lose money on the unit. Would you agree to release me from the lease once I find a replacement tenant who passes your usual checks? I'd keep paying the $1,850 rent until they move in, handle the listing and show the apartment around your schedule. If that works for you, I'm happy to put it in writing this week.
note: After a no to leaving early, ask what would make it work; a vetted replacement answers his real worry. Get any deal in writing, and check your state's rules on a landlord's duty to re-let.

situation: I rent my spare room to a lodger, Kofi, who's been with us 18 months, rent paid monthly on the 1st. My mum is moving in with us so I need the room back. Our agreement says one month's notice; I want to give him more and be kind about it. We're in the UK.
reply: Hi Kofi, I wanted to tell you in person first, and this is the written notice to go with it. My mum is moving in with us, so I need the spare room back, and I'm ending our lodging agreement on Monday 30 November. That's two months rather than the one month in our agreement, to give you proper time to find somewhere. Your rent stays as it is until then, and I'll return your £400 deposit on the day you move out. I'm very happy to be a reference, and you've been a great person to share the house with. Could you confirm you've received this?
note: A lodger in your home still gets exact dates in writing; giving more than the minimum notice and a reference is what keeps it kind.

situation: Vivo de alquiler en Madrid desde marzo de 2025, con un propietario particular, don Alfonso. El contrato pide 30 días de preaviso por escrito. Me mudo a Valencia por trabajo y quiero dejar el piso el 31 de octubre.
reply:
Estimado don Alfonso:
Le comunico que dejaré la vivienda de la calle Embajadores 112, 3.º B, y que el contrato terminará el 31 de octubre de 2026, conforme al preaviso de 30 días de la cláusula 4. Le envío también este aviso por burofax para que quede constancia. Pagaré el alquiler de octubre como siempre, y le propongo hacer la revisión del piso, la lectura de contadores y la entrega de llaves el sábado 31 a las 11:00. ¿Me podría confirmar por escrito que ha recibido este aviso?
Gracias por estos casi dos años, ha sido un placer.
Lucía Ortega
note: Fecha exacta, cláusula y constancia por escrito primero; la amabilidad va al final. Si el contrato prevé una indemnización por salida anticipada, revísala antes de enviar.
